en: Rayquaza's roar rang round the crater. The storm broke apart, and the titans were gone.
Rayquaza flew off into the clear sky...
Old Man
text: Bătrânul

en: Beyond here lies the Cave of Origin, where the spirits of Pokémon are said to rest.
text: Dincolo de aici se află Peștera Originii, unde se spune că se odihnesc spiritele Pokémonilor.

en: Nobody may go in. Please, turn back.
text: Nimeni nu are voie să intre. Te rog, întoarce-te.

en: Steven told me of you. Go on: Wallace is down there, and he has need of you.
text: Steven mi-a vorbit despre tine. Du-te: Wallace e acolo jos și are nevoie de tine.

en: Two Pokémon of legend, raging in our harbour... Only someone strong enough to stand before them may enter the cave now.
text: Doi Pokémon legendari, dezlănțuiți în portul nostru... Doar cine e destul de puternic să stea în fața lor poate intra acum în peșteră.

en: Rayquaza came down from the sky and the two of them went quiet. The spirits of the cave may rest again.
Still, nobody may go in. I will keep watch here, as I always have.
Steven
text: Steven

en: Sky Pillar... I've never been there. Where could it be, I wonder?
text: Pilonul Cerului... Nu am fost niciodată acolo. Unde o fi, oare?

en: So that was Rayquaza... It calmed the two of them just by appearing. I can hardly believe what I saw.
{player}, you did it. You woke it. Hoenn owes you a great deal.
The leaders of the two teams have gone. I hope they've learned something from all this.
Wallace's mentor Juan leads the Gym here. Go and show him what you can do!
I think you have just what it takes to help him...
Those Pokémon... Groudon and Kyogre, the two ancient Pokémon, woken from their long sleep...
And now they're hurling all their power at each other, and nothing can stop it.
...{player}. If you're here now, I'll take it you're ready to be part of this.
Then there's someone I'd like you to meet. Come with me, please.
Tell me, {player}. Seeing Groudon and Kyogre, do you think Pokémon are things to be afraid of?
They're not. Pokémon are so much more than that... But why am I asking you? You know that already.
Steven
Here we are. Inside, you'll find a man named Wallace.
I think you have just what it takes to help him...
Two enormous Pokémon are locked in battle. The water heaves and the air crackles round them.
text: Doi Pokémon uriași sunt prinși în luptă. Apa se zbate, iar aerul trosnește în jurul lor.

en: Maxie
text: Maxie

en: G-Groudon... Please, stop! I understand your power now!
text: G-Groudon... Te rog, oprește-te! Acum îți înțeleg puterea!

en: If you go on like this, it won't be only Sootopolis. All of Hoenn will be ruined!
text: Dacă continui așa, nu va fi ruinat doar Sootopolis. Întreaga Hoenn va fi ruinată!

en: All our schemes... and in the end, a single Pokémon set everything right. What fools we were.
The land Team Magma wanted... Perhaps it was best left as it was.
Archie
text: Archie

en: Kyogre! What's wrong? Look here, it's the Red Orb! Calm down! Kyogre!
text: Kyogre! Ce ai? Uite aici, e Globul Roșu! Calmează-te! Kyogre!

en: It's no use. It doesn't hear me at all!
text: Degeaba. Nu mă aude deloc!

en: What we tried to do meant nothing to the Pokémon themselves. Kyogre never wanted any of it.
I think I'll go back to the sea, and listen to it for a while.
Wallace
text: Wallace

en: {player}... The leaders of Team Magma and Team Aqua didn't mean any harm, I think.
text: {player}... Conducătorii Echipei Magma și ai Echipei Aqua nu au vrut răul, cred.

en: It wouldn't hurt to hear them out.
text: N-ar strica să-i ascultăm.

en: {player}, haven't you climbed Sky Pillar yet? Rayquaza is our only hope. Please, hurry!
{player}, thank you. Thanks to you and Rayquaza, Sootopolis and all of Hoenn are safe.
Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.
That holds Waterfall. With the Rain Badge from this city's Gym, your Pokémon can climb waterfalls with it.
The Gym is open again. My mentor Juan is waiting inside. Show him what you showed me!
Juan is the one who taught me everything. Even now, I find myself dazzled by his battles.
Kiri
text: Kiri

en: Big, big Pokémon are fighting! I'm scared...
text: Pokémoni mari, mari se bat! Mi-e frică...

en: A green Pokémon came down from the sky and the big ones went away! Was it a dream?
Hello! I'm Kiri. Here, you can have one of these!
And this one too!
When you make a wish, what do you wish for?
Do you like the season you were born in?
Me too! But I love autumn most of all.
Oh. Well, it doesn't really matter.
Woman
text: Femeia

en: The sky was clear this morning... then black clouds rolled in, rain came down in sheets, and the thunder started!
text: Cerul era senin azi-dimineață... apoi au venit nori negri, ploaia a căzut șiroaie, și a început tunetul!

en: Then it's scorching hot, and then it pours again. Is it all because of those Pokémon?
text: Apoi e o căldură dogoritoare, și apoi iar plouă. Oare totul e din cauza acelor Pokémon?

en: The clouds just... parted. Look, the sky over the crater is blue again!
Woman
text: Femeia

en: Sootopolis grew up inside the crater of a volcano. Look up, and you see the crater's rim all round.
text: Sootopolis a crescut în craterul unui vulcan. Privește în sus și vezi marginea craterului peste tot în jur.

en: All you see of the sky is a circle. That's why the sky over Sootopolis is the loveliest of all.
text: Din cer vezi doar un cerc. De aceea cerul de deasupra Sootopolis e cel mai frumos.

en: When two Pokémon that huge fight that fiercely, there's nothing any of us can do.
text: Când doi Pokémon atât de uriași se luptă atât de aprig, nimeni dintre noi nu poate face nimic.

en: That green Pokémon came down out of the circle of sky, and the fighting simply stopped.
Boy
text: Băiatul

en: I've never been out of this city. I wonder what the world's like on the other side of the round sky?
text: N-am ieșit niciodată din orașul ăsta. Mă întreb cum e lumea de partea cealaltă a cerului rotund?

en: Whoa, this is wild!
text: Uau, asta e nebunie!

en: Did you see it? It flew right down over the water! That was the coolest thing ever!
Boy
text: Băiatul

en: Diving in the sea, climbing up and down stairs all day... Live here and you can't help getting fit.
text: Să te scufunzi în mare, să urci și să cobori scări toată ziua... Dacă locuiești aici, nu ai cum să nu fii în formă.

en: Those giant Pokémon just appeared in the middle of the city! I've never seen them before!
text: Pokémonii aceia uriași au apărut chiar în mijlocul orașului! Nu i-am mai văzut până acum!

en: Why are they smashing into each other like that? Why can't they be friends?
text: De ce se izbesc așa unul de altul? De ce nu pot fi prieteni?

en: They stopped fighting! Maybe that green one told them to be friends.
Man
text: Bărbatul

en: You don't look like an ordinary tourist. What brings you all the way into the crater?
text: Nu pari un turist obișnuit. Ce te aduce tocmai în crater?

en: Man
text: Bărbatul

en: Pokémon of legend, right before my eyes! I never thought I'd see them for myself!
text: Pokémon legendari, chiar în fața ochilor mei! Nu credeam să-i văd vreodată cu ochii mei!

en: Three Pokémon of legend in one day! I'll be telling people about this for the rest of my life!
Girl
text: Fata

en: If they keep this up, Sootopolis will be smashed to pieces!
text: Dacă țin așa, Sootopolis va fi făcut bucăți!

en: The city's still standing! I was so sure it was all over.
Black Belt
text: Centură Neagră

en: Go, red one! Go, blue one! Hit him harder!
text: Hai, cel roșu! Hai, cel albastru! Dă-i mai tare!

en: ...Hey, do you know those Pokémon's names?
text: ...Hei, știi cum se numesc Pokémonii aceia?

en: Over already? Just as it was getting good! ...Not that I'm complaining, mind.
Boy
text: Băiatul

en: I don't think those two Pokémon are angry, somehow. I think... they just can't hold their own power back.
text: Nu cred că cei doi Pokémon sunt furioși, cumva. Cred că... pur și simplu nu-și pot stăpâni puterea.

en: The green one came and they let their power go. I think they were glad someone stopped them.
The door is shut tight.
text: Ușa e bine închisă.

en: The door is shut tight.
text: Ușa e bine închisă.
